'''Eyvind''' was a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
Eyvind was in love with [[Ariela]] and also [[Ariq Joanson]]'s best friend. He did not agree with Joanson's plans to make peace with the moisture farmers, [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] and the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]. Nonetheless, for his wedding Eyvind invited thirty-one Jawas to attend. Unfortunately, the young couple's future together was destroyed by a group of young Tuskens on a raiding venture stealing speeders from the guests, and as a result, Eyvind was killed.

==Behind the scenes==
"[[Wikipedia:Eyvind|Eyvind]]" is a common [[Wikipedia:Norway|Norwegian]] first name.
